filter.expression: (attribute.audit.model_alias = 'premium' AND attribute.audit.deployment EXISTS AND attribute.audit.deployment NOT LIKE 'openai/%') OR attribute.audit.reason LIKE '%premium_month_eur%served on big%'

description: A call on the premium class was answered by another model within the last 15 minutes. Either the gateway's audit record names premium as its alias and a deployment that is not OpenAI's: LiteLLM fell back to big because OpenAI failed the call, its credits spent or the API down (k8s/platform/litellm/helmrelease.yaml); add OpenAI credits. Or the record's reason names the premium cap and served on big: the gateway ran the call on big because budget.premium_month_eur could not fit it; raise the cap in factory/policy.yaml or wait for the next UTC month. The label event marks the fallback as an event: factoryd closes no card when the alert clears.
